content:
mira: ap-northeast-1 dedicated pool (pool-42) at 95% GPU alloc. queue depth rising, several orgs seeing latency spikes. low-priority jobs are being evicted. thinking we should start a hosted fallback runbook now.
jon: got the same. M3 median latency for text-gen up ~2.8x in the last 6m. p99 token latency climbing. metrics: `gpu_util 95%, queued_reqs 420, evictions 14/min`
eli: are these mostly long-context jobs or short chat bursts? that informs cache vs batch strategy.
mira: mix, but heavy seq length >8k for a few tenants. KV cache thrash.
dev-ops: if we shift traffic, prefer weight-based progressive shift by org. don't want a big cold-start shock to hosted pools.
mira: agreed. propose: 1) open hosted fallback for ap-northeast-1 2) increase hosted routing weight +20% for low-priority orgs, +10% for regular for 10m 3) enable lameduck on pool-42 to stop new allocations 4) monitor errors and cost signal.
jon: +1. runbook commands below. i'll execute step 1/3 after a quick smoke.
jon: ```
# bump hosted weight for ap-northeast-1
curl -X POST "https://routing.internal.redwood/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORCH_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-1","delta_weights":{"hosted":0.2}}'
# mark pool as lameduck
curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/pools/pool-42/drain" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN"
```
mira: running the weight bump for low-priority classes now. will do progressive ramp every 1m.
deploy-bot: weightswitch job started by jon. job_id=ws-20260320-1302
sara: tagging ops:apn1 and product impacted teams. oncall-sre pls keep an eye on rollback triggers (error rate >2% or cpu throttling).
eli: cost-team, raising hosted by 20% briefly will add bill. any hard limits?
cost-team: we have a buffer for emergency fallbacks but keep the change scoped to lowest priority classes. notify before >50% additional hosted capacity.
mira: observed immediate drop in queued_reqs to 250 after first ramp. p95 latency down ~30%.
jon: rolling another +10% for low-priority; leaving regular at +10 for now.
dev-ops: watch for KV cache misses on hosted; we might need to enable prefix caching warmup for migrated sessions.
mira: enabling prefix prewarm for top 10 orgs migrating now.
jon: deploy-bot reports ws-20260320-1302 completed: hosted weight +0.25 applied.
deploy-bot: audit: {"job_id":"ws-20260320-1302","region":"ap-northeast-1","delta_hosted":0.25,"initiator":"jon"}
eli: any errors showing up in routing? 502 spikes?
jon: small bump in 502s for one tenant tied to model mismatch (model v1 vs v1-quant). i've pinned that tenant to hosted-compatible variant, routing fallback engaged.
mira: good catch. can we auto-fallback model variant on mismatch?
dev-ops: that's on the roadmap, for now we have per-org variant mapping. i pushed a quick mapping change for that tenant.
sara: posting status update to #incidents and customer-watchlist.
cost-team: quick note — estimate +$1.2k/hr while at this level. confirm once stabilized if we should reduce to +15% soon.
mira: if latency remains <1.5x baseline and queue <150, start wind-down to +10% after 15m.
jon: 12m in: queue 120, evictions down to 2/min, p95 back near baseline. ready to start gradual rollback to +10% for low-priority.
mira: initiate rollback sequence and keep lameduck until pool drops to <70% alloc.
jon: ```
# reduce hosted weight
curl -X POST "https://routing.internal.redwood/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORCH_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-1","delta_weights":{"hosted":-0.15}}'
```
dev-ops: holding rollback. will watch for any latency regression for the next 3m before finalizing.
jon: rollback applied, hosted delta now +0.10 from baseline. queue 95. p95 stable.
mira: keeping pool-42 lameduck for another 20m to let active sessions drain. filing post-incident note and update runbook with the model-variant fallback step.
sara: closing loop with product teams and sent a customer-facing note draft.
cost-team: ack — recorded extra spend. will invoice to incident budget.
mira: thanks all. root cause: sudden high long-context load from a small number of tenants causing KV thrash + allocation saturation. action items: 1) add auto-model-variant fallback 2) prewarm prefix caching on big migrations 3) alerting tweak for queue depth >300 in 5m. i'll create tickets. :white_check_mark:
jon: adding tickets now.
eli: nice quick ops. :thumbsup:
